storyboardBeats.narration: Most road-trip breakdowns start as a ten-minute check somebody skipped.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Forensic-scan style close-up of a car's front tire and wheel well under bright inspection-bay light, faint scan-line HUD glow sweeping across the surface, clean dark background, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Four: tread depth. Worn tread on hot highway miles is a blowout waiting on a schedule.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro of a tire tread depth gauge probe pressing into worn tread grooves, forensic scan-line glow highlighting the shallow depth, clean dark field, slow controlled push-in, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Three: pressure — all five tires, including the spare nobody's looked at since it came off the truck.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a tire pressure gauge on a valve stem, then a slow reveal pan to a spare tire in a trunk well under a forensic scan-line glow, clean dark field, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Two: belts and hoses. A hairline crack you can't feel is exactly what quits at mile two hundred.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Engine-bay macro of a serpentine belt and radiator hose under inspection-bay light, forensic scan-line glow sweeping to highlight a fine surface crack, clean dark field, slow push-in, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: One: fluid levels. Low is cheap to catch in the driveway. Empty is expensive on the shoulder.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of an engine oil dipstick being checked and a coolant reservoir level line, forensic scan-line glow marking the fill level, clean dark field, 9:16 vertical framing
